column1: # The shared secret shapes (seam S12), one line per literal, in priority order.
# Format: kind, a tab, guard, a tab, the regex. guard is 1 when the left guard applies (a match
# right after a letter, digit or _ is dropped unless that byte ends an escape; PRD-05 section 4),
# else 0. Lines starting with # are comments; blank lines are skipped. No regex holds a tab.
# The span is group 1 when the regex has a capture group, else the whole match.
# Read with include_str! by src/mask/rules.rs and by crates/goalcup-verify, which ignores the
# guard column. The line order is the rule order: the JSON literal (line 10, counting data
# lines from 0) and the shell literal (line 11) must not move. Add a literal only at the end.
